assets.name: library-room.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: immersive background for the first screen of a literary reading web app, landscape 3:2 composition, one coherent room photograph.
Primary request: A modest, intimate Korean personal library / writing room, photographed with warm fine-grain film and a very subtle painterly texture. Dark walnut wood bookshelves around the room hold assorted well-loved vintage books with plain, unlettered spines. Cream plaster walls, delicate dust floating in afternoon sunlight entering from a window on the left. Warm, quiet, lived-in and understated, carefully observed material textures.
Composition/framing: wide horizontal 3:2 image, calm frontal view with gentle natural perspective. Reserve generous clean deep brown/shadow negative space in the left upper-middle area for a website title that will be added later. In the center-right, a low broad walnut book shelf or cabinet has a clear empty horizontal top surface and visible space above it, intended for a single front-facing book that will be placed with HTML later. Do not put a featured book in this empty display spot. Surrounding books and modest room props should frame the clear center-right display area without crowding it. The lower shelf surface is grounded and believable. Left window light produces warm directional illumination and subtle shadows. Avoid a bright white hotspot behind the left text area.
Style/medium: refined warm film photograph with subtle painterly surface detail, realistic depth and grain, elegant muted cream, walnut, honey and shadow colors, no oversaturated orange, no excessive clutter.
Constraints: no people, no readable text, no letters on books, no words, no logos, no watermark, no computer or phone screens, no UI, no posters with writing. This is only the room background, not a website mockup.

authorCreditEdit.prompt:

Primary request: Add only one new author-credit line in the empty cream space just below the existing subtitle. Exact new text: "김승제 지음". The name is 김승제 (김 / 승 / 제), not any other spelling. Use small, neat Korean serif type, dark brown matching the current text, left-aligned with the subtitle (roughly x=155 in the 1024-pixel-wide cover). The author credit should be about 24 pixels high at this cover size and located about one line of space below the subtitle, around y=560.
All existing text must remain completely unchanged: title on two lines "잘 지내냐고" and "물으면"; subtitle "대답이 조금 길어질 것 같다".
Change only the addition of "김승제 지음"; do not move, rewrite, enlarge, replace, or redraw any existing text or illustration. No extra text, logos, border, or watermark.

mustardBottleEdit.source: Existing book cover and user-provided yellow squeeze-bottle reference
mustardBottleEdit.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: existing Korean literary book cover, flat 1024x1536 portrait artwork.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Input image 2 is only a mustard squeeze-bottle SHAPE reference.
The upright bottle in image 1 is far too large and posed. CHANGE ONLY that mustard bottle and its immediate cast shadow.
Replace it with the same recognizably yellow, softly contoured plastic mustard squeeze bottle with white flip cap, but much smaller and LYING ON ITS SIDE on the refrigerator top. This is an incidental forgotten household object, not a product display. Sideways three-quarter view, its long axis almost horizontal, gently diagonal toward the lower right, with the white cap at its right end. Let it rest physically on the surface with a soft contact shadow, in the same quiet spot at bottom center. The whole bottle including cap should occupy only approximately 230 pixels wide by 105 pixels high in a 1024x1536 cover, centered near (525, 1225). Do not leave any part of the giant upright bottle: restore the original warm cream background and soft blue window shadows in the area it occupied above. No upright bottle, no big foreground hero object.
Match the original loose watercolor/gouache texture with quiet, slightly desaturated warm mustard-yellow, gentle blue-gray shadows, and subtle edges. No brand label, no text, no logos on the bottle. Preserve the surrounding refrigerator and left-hand little food container, warm light from the right, ivory textured paper, and all other composition.
Text invariants: "잘 지내냐고" / "물으면" title exactly unchanged, same position, size and elegant Korean lettering. Subtitle "대답이 조금 길어질 것 같다" exactly unchanged. No author text or any other added text. Preserve generous blank space. The bottle should look casually set down and emotionally understated, not centrally posed merchandise.
